name: Orkas
description: Orkas is an open-source (MIT), local-first AI team for your desktop: a Commander turns your goal into to-dos and coordinates 16 built-in specialist agents plus Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw and Hermes, with projects, scheduled automations and connectors. Free app for macOS & Windows; built-in models or your own keys.
one_liner: A free desktop app where you tell an AI 'Commander' your goal, and it splits the goal into to-do items and hands them to a team of specialist AI helpers that keep the work moving over time.
buyer: A solo small-business owner or freelancer who wants an ongoing AI 'staff' handling recurring tasks without hiring anyone.
business_use_cases: A solo consultant sets up a recurring weekly automation, like drafting the client status report every Friday, and the Commander keeps it running unattended.
A small e-commerce owner assigns separate agents to inventory emails and customer-support drafts, reviewing finished work each morning.
An agency owner uses the project and to-do structure to keep a long client engagement organized across many AI sessions instead of starting over each time.

money_ideas.idea: The built-in credits model for the proprietary Orkas model is already usage-based; a business could resell curated agent 'packs' for specific trades.
A paid setup service that configures scheduled automations for non-technical small-business owners.

steal_this: Pick one repetitive weekly task a local business owner complains about, configure it as a scheduled automation in this tool, and sell the finished setup as a flat $200 one-time service.
